children: Royal Unibrew narrowed its 2026 organic EBIT growth guidance to 6–8% from 6–10%, corresponding to EBIT of DKK 2,325–2,380M versus DKK 2,202M in 2025. Net revenue is expected slightly above 2025; CAPEX is now expected at 6% of net revenue, down from around 7%.
2026 organic EBIT growth guidance: 6–8%, down from 6–10%
The narrower range reduces the upper end of the outlook and signals greater pressure from costs and market conditions.
2026 EBIT outlook: DKK 2,325–2,380M vs DKK 2,202M in 2025
The forecast implies higher EBIT than 2025, but the release provides no prior forecast comparison in absolute DKK.
Quarterly EBIT growth supports the positive full-year outlook; no prior-period EBIT amount was provided.
Q3 net revenue grew ~4%, adjusted for exited activities
Underlying growth excludes lower-margin activities, so it may not reflect reported revenue growth.
2026 CAPEX expected at 6% of net revenue, from ~7%
Lower expected investment reflects project timing, with some investments expected in 2027.

This is a Q3 trading update showing continued operating growth alongside a narrower full-year outlook. Investors will look for subsequent results to confirm the revised EBIT range and whether inflation and supply-chain pressures ease.
